info.name: rental-engine: Rightmove HTTP
info.description:
Rightmove search discovery via plain HTTP (scraped). No auth required. Realistic browser headers are required.

Base URL: https://www.rightmove.co.uk
Typeahead: https://los.rightmove.co.uk/typeahead

Flow per discover_properties() call:
1. Resolve location name to locationIdentifier via typeahead API (or use known-ID table)
2. Fetch paginated search pages
3. Extract property IDs from __NEXT_DATA__ JSON embedded in each page
4. Return deduplicated property URLs

Known region IDs for the rental-engine search profile are in rightmove_api.py's _KNOWN_IDS table, populated by scripts/resolve_region_ids.py. Never hand-enter these.

IMPORTANT: Rightmove may block programmatic requests in some environments. The pipeline uses a 1.5s page delay. If blocked, the response will be a redirect to rightmove.co.uk/error/ or a page-not-found URL.

request.description:
Resolve a location name to a Rightmove REGION^ID. The pipeline uses the first match with type='REGION'.

Note: The typeahead endpoint is on los.rightmove.co.uk, not www.rightmove.co.uk. The www.rightmove.co.uk/typeAhead/... endpoint returns 404.

Result format: {matches: [{id, type, displayName}]}. Build locationIdentifier as f"{match['type']}^{match['id']}".
